'''Rising''' is a horse from the [[Royal Palace of Andor|Royal Palace]] of [[Andor]].

==Appearance==
Rising is a very fast, tall, dun gelding.

==Activities==
Rising carries [[Birgitte Silverbow]] to [[Elayne Trakand]]'s coronation in [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|13|52}}
